claim: *Document-mutation structural model.* The reduction preserves one architectural relation: ordinary remediation reaches format-specific mutation through a structured-document seam. Enforcement of that relation is a separate Alignment decision.

topology.description: Remediation→sanctioned document abstraction→format implementation→four concrete formats; no enforcement claim.

required_terms: Structured document model The sanctioned seam
Marks where mutation belongs; does not itself prevent bypass.
bw_encoding: Only the explicitly named sanctioned seam uses 8%; ordinary logic, implementation and format artifacts white.
redesign: Only the explicitly named sanctioned seam uses 8%; ordinary logic, implementation and format artifacts white. Vertical chain and shared horizontal format fan-out rail.
alt: Remediation logic operates through the structured document model, the sanctioned seam. A format-specific implementation realizes that model for DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and PDF. The seam identifies where mutation should occur but does not itself prevent bypass.

review.reference: current authored SVG (not older D2 receipts)
review.outcome: Model layer gray contrasts with format implementation and outputs. Sanctioned seam retains heavier border; no enforcement claim introduced.
review.strict_compile: zero warnings, overfull boxes, missing glyphs or errors
